Maya Chen: Hi all 1 1 starting kickoff for ValenTech onboarding. Objectives: confirm owners, define measurable success criteria, and set a 30-day ramp timeline. Key items: SSO, sample data ingest, perf baseline, enablement plan. Risk note: AE flagged 'unsigned-contract-90d' in CRM. Can we assign renewal monitoring?

Eli Turner: I can cover infra contacts today. Tech leads: Marco P. (infra) and Noor K. (integrations). I'll schedule an infra preflight Thu 10am PT.

Jared Kim: Good call. Marco wants the preliminary runbook and list of required test accounts before the preflight.

Priya Rao: I'll run enablement. Proposed schedule: Day 2 5m onboarding demo, Day 5 deep integration lab, Day 12 troubleshooting + obs walk-through. Need a demo dataset (~300-600 rows) and a short prompt bank to build exercises. Will record and colocate slides.

Sophie Alvarez: Draft KPIs to include in the shared doc: 1) Integration: E2E test success 2) Perf: p50 <250ms for core endpoints 3) Cost: within +7% of estimate month 1 4) Enablement engagement: 3+ engineer attendees, avg rating >=4 5) Data: sample set validated and schema signed off. I'll add to the doc.

Maya Chen: Thanks. I'll create the shared success doc and a timeline. Who will watch the renewal flag in CRM?

Jared Kim: I'll take renewal tracking. Suggest weekly 15m health check (Wed 9am PT). Also add a fallback model variant plan to the runbook for performance degradation.

ops-bot: Action: create calendar invites using template "cs - kickoff v2". Include Zoom, success doc link, and owner tags.

Priya Rao: I'll make a quick feedback form to capture session ratings and blockers after each enablement session. Will post link in channel after first session.

Maya Chen: Action recap: Maya -> create success doc + timeline; Eli -> send infra preflight invite; Priya -> enablement content + feedback form; Jared -> runbook + renewal tracker + run weekly health sync; Sophie -> add KPIs. Reconvene Fri for 15m status check. :thumbsup: 

Eli Turner: Sent infra invite and included Marco & Noor. Checklist for preflight: SSO test user, sample payload schema, perf script (example below).

Eli Turner: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hello"}'
```

Maya Chen: Perfect. I'll link the success doc when ready and tag owners per ops-bot guidance. Ping me for urgent blockers.
